text_block_list.text: Christmas—
25 days before the incident.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's something
I'd love for you to see.

What Eishin Flash brought over so enthusiastically
was a box-shaped item with a Christmas illustration on it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's an advent calendar.
Have you not heard of one before?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Christmas is taken very seriously in Germany.
So, there are various festivities held leading up to the day.
Advent calendars are one of them.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
See these little numbered windows?
You open one window each day until Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "What's inside is... Go ahead and open today's portion right away to find out."
Just as Eishin Flash instructed, I push open the small window. Out from inside came a small, golden package.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Those are chocolates.
This calendar contains 25 days' worth of treats."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Indeed. What's inside is a surprise for the day of.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'd be glad if you could keep the countdown to Christmas in mind.
choice_data_list: Come on, Flash, let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, there isn't any for me.
I made this specifically for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I made the sweets inside myself.
Every single one is a different kind.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Because it's Christmas, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Though that's not quite all there is to it.
choice_data_list: Let me help you with something too.
Let me help with something too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No, I've been preparing for this for three months, so there's no need for you to help.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We plan to prepare food and cake for the day of the event as well.
Please look forward to it!
Though she says that, it feels wrong to be on the receiving end all the time. Just as I was wondering if I could at least give her a Christmas present—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—I received the same wreath as well.
Though the message is different.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"May the joy of making your debut last forever throughout the rest of your athletic career."
...It seems that was the sentiment put into it.

...25 days left until Christmas.
I picked up my smartphone to look for
a class I could attend between work—

And in the days leading up to Christmas...
Eishin Flash was working tirelessly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Hmph... hmph... phew...!
(Thuuump!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Shall we begin?

What Eishin Flash carried over with ease
was a massive log that easily looked over two meters long.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was able to procure a Nordmann fir,
so I will begin pruning it now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: By the day of the event, it'll be a magnificent Christmas tree, so look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Did you open today's advent calendar?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They're shaped like teddy bears.
I don't often get the chance to make gummies, so it was a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well then, I have tasks to attend to, so please excuse me.
And on another day—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then, a 5-kilogram goose, please.
I'll come pick it up on the day.

text_block_list.name: Butcher Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: You got it! I'll make sure to stock the very best!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Next is the greengrocer. 4 kg of potatoes,
4 heads of red cabbage, 2 kg of apples—
And so, I watched over her as she worked hard in training while running all over the place to prepare—

—And then, Christmas Day arrived.
When I opened the last door of the advent calendar with Eishin Flash...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I made it out of marzipan.
It's sweet and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we've opened all of them.
Thank you for your hard work.
choice_data_list: Thank you, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It made me happy to receive updates
from you every morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now then, regarding the schedule
for the Christmas party—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We chat while we eat.
That is all.

"After all that enthusiastic preparation for the party,
it turned out to be unexpectedly simple,
which caught me a bit off guard."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is all. I was only handling the preparations for the meals and decorations to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Then I'll bring the food right over.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Is this... a wreath?
The present I gave to Eishin Flash was a Christmas wreath that I had spent time painstakingly crafting.
choice_data_list: It's a bit rough compared to what your parents make, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer, did you... make this...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: For... my sake...?

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Let us pray.
For Flash's happiness..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
I'm just so, so happy...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Christmas is a very special day for me,
one that I spend with my family.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "However, last year I lacked peace of mind and was unable to properly cherish Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Besides... I didn't think there would be anyone to spend it with.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If it only makes me miss my family and feel lonely...
I had thoughts like that too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yet in truth, you always had someone...
watching over you like family, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"So this year, partly to express my gratitude to that person...
I wanted to make it a wonderful Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"And in doing so, I ended up receiving
a wonderful present myself."
choice_data_list: I'm always the one on the receiving end, though.
I'm the one who's always receiving from you, though.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No, I am the one who—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. We won't get anywhere like this.
Besides, the food is waiting, so shall we get the party started?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"What would you like to start with?
We have carp dishes as well."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...I expected that reaction. It is called Karpfen blau—a splendid traditional Christmas dish."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Carp dishes don't seem to be very common in Japan.
Even Falcon-san was surprised by it—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—That is why, as a child, I believed in my heart
that Santa Claus must truly exist.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I drew up a capture plan in my own way and carried it out...
As a result, I ended up thoroughly shocking my parents.
We talked about so many things after that while relishing Eishin Flash's cooking...
...Moved by Eishin Flash's extraordinary dedication to Christmas... I wondered if there was a way to bring an even bigger smile to her face.

"And while savoring the food
and enjoying our conversation—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pardon me~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san and Trainer-san!
Merry Christmaaas♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san?
Why are you over here...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's not just Falco!
Everyone else, come on over too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san.
Merry Christmas♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Merry Chris~
Whoa, the food looks amazing! Lemme take a pic!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Curren-san, Jordan-san...
And so many other people...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, just so you know beforehand, I have no intention of ruining your quiet Christmas, Flash-san, okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But before that~... I want you to enjoy a lively, bustling Japanese Christmas too☆
choice_data_list: I'm the one who called you here.
I'm the one who called them.

text_block_list.text:
"There is no one to spend time with."
She seemed to feel that way last year... but not anymore.
choice_data_list: You have plenty of friends by your side.
You have so many friends by your side.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. That's right.
That was it...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm... so glad I got to spend Christmas here today,
at this academy—

"When she smiled just then,
she looked just like an innocent child."
